scope: Prospective post-review matched protocol-model extension; independent of the frozen confirmatory registry

primaryContrast.decisionRule: lower endpoint of the paired seed-cluster 95% bootstrap CI exceeds 0.05

safetyRules: duplicate exposure does not exceed the issued fallback-risk cap
worldMatching: Request, attack, witness, delivery and contact draws are keyed by scenario and seed, never by method label.
